common.sampler: alternate positive/proven-unmatched pair; uniform house then uniform pair; random.Random(seed)
common.initialization: identical initial shared weights and sampling order; train each variant from start
common.followup_gate: primary contrast improves at feasible frozen workpoint

independent_switch_semantics.context_off: zero context input to fusion gate and mask context branch; retain structure, geometry and intra attention
independent_switch_semantics.retrieval_off: skip query/memory retrieval; use zero retrieval score channels, retain descriptor and geometry scoring and Sinkhorn

experiment_b.verifier: one shared verifier trained on fit-only candidate union, frozen before selection comparison
experiment_b.compatibility: existing verifier binds R3 checkpoint; never bypass identity checks to reuse V1 for A0-A3
experiment_b.denominator: all fixed floor image pairs, with detection misses and rejected pairs retained

acceptance_tests: context off: perturb context branch cannot change gate or descriptors
retrieval off: perturb memory cannot change matcher scores with fixed descriptors
full/full reproduces historical forward behavior; empty candidates and transpose symmetry preserved
checkpoint resume preserves variant; cross-variant cache reuse rejected
training gradients reach enabled branches; disabled modules are not represented as trained
fit/selection isolation; frozen thresholds only on development validation; no GT in inference
